summary: Behaviour-preserving refactor of the @cipherstash/cli package. Seven user-facing literals (help banner/usage prefixes, unknown command/subcommand errors, region prompt, cancel text, db migrate stub warning) are moved into a new internal `src/messages.ts` constant object and imported by both the production call sites and the E2E tests. Every extracted value is byte-identical to the literal it replaces and the surrounding template interpolation (`: ${token}`) is unchanged, so rendered CLI output is the same. messages.ts is bundled into dist/bin/stash.js by tsup (no new entry, export or dependency). The only material side effect is on test semantics: the E2E assertions now read their expected text from the same constants production uses, so they no longer detect a change to that copy, and an emptied constant would make the corresponding `toContain` trivially pass. AGENTS.md guidance is updated accordingly and is not part of the npm package files. Low impact; ready for normal review.

behaviour_changes.description: Seven user-facing CLI strings are sourced from a new `messages` const object instead of inline literals. Values and the surrounding format are identical to base, so stdout/stderr output, exit codes and prompts are unchanged.

E2E smoke and auth-cancel tests now assert on `messages.*` constants rather than literal strings. They no longer pin the user-facing copy; they pin only that the built binary's output contains whatever the source constant currently holds. The db migrate assertion is tightened from a substring to the full warning string.
packages/cli/AGENTS.md (contributor/agent guidance, not shipped in the npm `files` list) now instructs that test-asserted strings live in src/messages.ts.

failure_scenarios.title: E2E tests no longer catch regressions in asserted CLI copy
failure_scenarios.trigger: A later edit changes or empties a value in src/messages.ts (e.g. a typo, or `usagePrefix: ''`), or a scripted consumer relies on the old wording.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: Tests take their expected strings from `messages.*` (smoke.e2e.test.ts lines 18-72, auth-login-cancel.e2e.test.ts lines 11-17), so expected and actual change together; `toContain('')` passes trivially for an emptied constant.
failure_scenarios.consequence: A user-visible copy regression (help banner, error prefix, cancel text) ships without a red test. Output is cosmetic; exit codes are still asserted separately.

existing_verification.description: Exit codes and user-supplied tokens are still asserted with literals in smoke.e2e.test.ts.

missing_verification: No check that messages.ts values are non-empty or match an intended snapshot.
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Accept as the intended design; optionally add a tiny unit/snapshot test over the `messages` object so copy changes are deliberate.

verification_gaps.description: E2E tests that cover the touched paths exist and are wired into CI, but no CI result or local run was available, so the refactor's output equivalence is established by reading the diff only.

recommended_controls.description: Confirm `pnpm exec turbo run test:e2e --filter @cipherstash/cli` passes on this head (it builds dist first).
Optionally snapshot the `messages` object (or assert non-empty values) so copy changes show up in review.

coverage_limitations.effect: Verification confidence is capped at medium; test status is exists_not_run.

evidence.claim: HELP template interpolates messages.cli.versionBannerPrefix and usagePrefix in the same positions as the former literals.
db migrate warning, unknown db subcommand and unknown command messages use constants with the same `: ${token}` suffix and the same exit codes as base.
Auth help usage prefix and unknown-subcommand error use messages.auth constants with unchanged format.
selectRegion prompt message and cancel text come from messages.auth; process.exit(0) on cancel unchanged.
Constant values are byte-identical to the literals removed in the diff.
Cancel test waits for and asserts on messages.auth constants instead of literals.
Smoke tests assert exit codes and user tokens literally, and copy via messages.* constants.
Guidance updated to point test-asserted strings at src/messages.ts.
npm `files` lists dist, README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md; AGENTS.md is not shipped.
The bin build bundles src/bin/stash.ts (skipNodeModulesBundle only externalises node_modules), so relative ../messages.js is inlined.
E2E tests spawn the built dist/bin/stash.js.
